_comment: Mutations that remove the guarantees added by the trading-gate fix:
the gate must NAME its cause, and an unverifiable start-up latch must
self-heal while an operator's kill switch must not.
K, L and M are the fail-closed branches in
TradingController._restore_emergency_stop() -- the branch that
latched production's trading off for a whole day on 2026-10-19 after a
momentary Redis blip at bot start.
A and B are the SAME guarantee guarded in two places: the controller
checks the latch's origin before it delegates, and the RiskManager
refuses to release an operator latch on its own. B is pinned by a test
that calls the RiskManager directly. A was NOT pinned: with B still
in place, removing A changes no observable behaviour, so mutation A
SURVIVED the first run of this spec on 2026-10-19. That was a real gap
in the suite, not a false positive -- the controller's guard was
unexercised. It is now pinned by
test_controller_refuses_to_release_an_operator_latch_on_its_own, which
stubs the RiskManager's release to SUCCEED so the controller's own
refusal has to hold on its own.
All 14 are expected KILLED.
Run with:  python tools/mutation_harness.py tools/mutations/trading_gate_reasons.json
NEVER run concurrently with a test run or tools/review_fanout.py -- both will
read a file that is mid-mutation and report on code that does not exist.

mutations.label: A: the controller's operator-initiated guard is removed
mutations.replace: # MUTANT: the operator-initiated guard was removed.

mutations.label: B: the RiskManager's own operator-initiated guard is removed
mutations.needle:
if self._emergency_stop_operator_initiated:
            # An operator's kill switch. Only clear_emergency_stop() may
            # release it.
            return False
mutations.replace: # MUTANT: the RiskManager-side operator guard was removed.

mutations.label: C: the self-heal fails OPEN when Redis cannot be read

            logger.critical(
                f"[EmergencyStop] Still cannot verify the emergency-stop state "
                f"for user {self.user_id}: {exc}. Staying STOPPED (fail-closed).",
                exc_info=True,
            )
            return False
